description: This file defines API routes for a FastAPI-based service that handles encapsulation of Ethernet frames into FSO segments, including endpoints for encapsulation and dequeue operations for TX and RX segments.

classes.description: A simple dependency injection provider for the EncapsulationService.

methods.name: list[EncapsulatedSegment] tx_dequeue(n: int = 10, svc: EncapsulationService = Depends(get_service))

methods.name: list[EncapsulatedSegment] rx_dequeue(n: int = 10, svc: EncapsulationService = Depends(get_service))
methods.description: API endpoint to dequeue up to n RX segments.
